title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 2 Clause 34 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 2 Clause 34 - Public Servant “Public Servant” means a public servant as defined in section 21 of the Penal code, 1860 (Act No. XLV of 1860); Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
